Superseded by the 2024 Amendment: VISITECT CD4 for advanced HIV disease is used for AHD screening of new positives, returners after ≥6 months' interruption and clients with VL >1000 copies/mL; quantitative CD4 for follow-up (Amendment Chapter 6).

Superseded by the 2024 Amendment: all DTG and PI treatment failures need a genotype-guided switch: refer to the National HIVDR Clinical Expert Committee and switch to 2nd line only if the resistance test shows DTG (or PI) resistance, with the regimen set by the genotype; LPV/r can be changed to ATV/r once ≥40 kg regardless of VL; DRV/r only for confirmed INSTI resistance (Amendment 9.7, updated second-line table).

Superseded by the 2024 Amendment: any ill-appearing HIV-exposed child <5 years is at risk of advanced HIV disease: if same-day HIV diagnostics are exhausted, start ART presumptively while awaiting PCR results, sending two DNA PCR samples before initiation (no need to await results); the Amendment lists the criteria for a presumptive diagnosis of severe HIV disease (Amendment 9.1).

Superseded by the 2024 Amendment: breastfeeding infants of mothers found to have seroconverted get 3-drug PEP after appropriate testing (Amendment Chapter 8).

Superseded by the 2024 Amendment: first routine VL at 3 months; up to 3MMD after a suppressed VL at 3 months, up to 6MMD after 2 consecutive suppressed VLs.
